justification: One marketing page following the existing /for/<audience> pattern, plus a footer link. No code path, no query, no data. Minor because nothing computes: it is copy and two links.

break_it.scenario: A student or lecturer arrives at plotdetect.com.au and has to work out which of 119 pages is relevant.
break_it.what_happens: They leave. The site has ten report types and six audience pages and none of them says anything about teaching or study.
break_it.how: A seventh /for/ page in the established pattern, linked from the footer beside the other audiences. Two clear doors — student, lecturer — and one button each.

break_it.scenario: A new microsite or bespoke layout is built for this audience instead.
break_it.what_happens: A seventh design to maintain, diverging from six pages that already share SiteNav, SiteFooter and layout.
break_it.how: Copied the structure of /for/councils exactly: same nav, footer, max-width, card grid and teal accent. No new components.
break_it.repro: diff the section structure against app/for/councils/page.tsx

break_it.scenario: The page sells to students and they discover the gaps themselves.
break_it.what_happens: The audience whose entire value is honest bug reports learns the tool oversold itself. Trust is the only currency here and it does not come back.
break_it.how: The limitations sit BEFORE the call to action, not after: the unresolvable citations, the 28-council coverage, Wingecarribee, and that nothing has been tested against a council determination. Plus the line that matters for graded work — check the source and cite the source, not this tool.
break_it.repro: read the amber section; it precedes the two buttons

break_it.scenario: The student button points at the info site rather than the app.
break_it.what_happens: A student lands back on marketing instead of the tool, on a site with 119 pages.
break_it.how: It points at verify.plotdetect.com.au/assessment — the subdomain middleware.ts routes to Site Controls — and the page tells students to prefer their lecturer's link because that one carries the class code.

post_merge.watch: If lecturers arrive but do not email, the 'I teach a class' door is not doing its job and the offer needs to be more concrete, not louder.
post_merge.manual_verify: Open /for/students. Confirm the limitations appear ABOVE the two buttons, the student button opens Site Controls on the verify subdomain, and the footer lists 'For Students' with the other audiences.
